subject: Case study excerpt & staged press opt-in — embargo window and logo permissions
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@brightgrid.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightGrid Legal <legal@brightgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short case study excerpt + logo usage (timing)

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Internal marketing at BrightGrid would like to put together a short one-paragraph customer excerpt and include the Redwood logo in a small case study callout on our website and partner page. We want to coordinate timing so the customer quote aligns with our Q3 product announcement.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can Redwood sign off on a one-paragraph excerpt (quote+context) and a small logo placement (PNG/svg) for web only?
- We need any publicity permission language in the MSA/order form by next Friday so our marketer can prepare assets.
- We understand some customers ask for an embargo window; can we propose a staged opt-in: internal blog (BrightGrid) on 2026-08-15, public case study on 2026-08-22 if we get final signoff.

I attached our draft excerpt (BrightGrid_CaseStudy_Draft_v3.docx) — can you confirm what Redwood needs in terms of approval and any required redline language for publicity/reference rights? If helpful, I can loop in our procurement/legal contact.

Appreciate it — hope we can include Redwood as a spotlight.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Head of Demand Gen, BrightGrid
alex@brightgrid.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short case study excerpt + logo usage (timing)

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the draft and timeline. Happy to get this moving. High-level constraints from Redwood/legal: we typically require:
- Written approval of final quoted language (customer signs off) before any published excerpt;
- A narrow license for logo use limited to the web and partner materials (no redistribution in paid collateral without separate permission);
- A 7-day approval turnaround once we receive final assets;
- If the customer wants an embargo, we need the embargo dates listed in the order form as part of the publicity carveout.

I took a quick pass at a short publicity clause we can add to the order form. Attaching a redline for the MSA/order form with suggested language (redlines_msa_20260622.pdf). Ben — tagging you for the recommended wording for quote attribution (we want to avoid product-specific claims).

Proposed staged opt-in looks fine. To keep timelines realistic, we need the final customer-approved quote by 2026-07-30. If that slips we should push the public case study date.

Mina
Manager, Customer Marketing (on behalf of Legal ops)
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Quoted attachments: redlines_msa_20260622.pdf (2 pages redline)

Mina — quick notes on the public-facing language.

1) Attribution line: keep it high-level and avoid any numeric claims about performance. Suggested: "BrightGrid reduced time-to-insight for internal analytics workflows using Redwood Inference" — that frames the value without product/sla claims.
2) Logo: we should provide a small "partner" variant and a usage spec (clear space, color variants). Include this as an asset package rather than license the full brand kit.
3) Embargos: if BrightGrid needs a staged opt-in, let's put a two-week internal review buffer before the public date so legal/marketing can react to last-minute edits. So: internal release 2026-08-15, customer signoff by 2026-07-30, public release 2026-08-29 (one week later than your proposed public date) — this creates a slight buffer.

Olga — can you confirm whether the following MSA clause is safe from a legal exposure perspective: "Customer grants Redwood a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use Customer's name and logo for marketing purposes limited to web and partner listings, subject to Customer's prior written approval for each use, with any embargo dates to be listed on the order form." If ok, we'll fold into the redline.

Ben
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Mina/Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and suggested language. A couple of clarifying points from our legal team: 
- They want the license to explicitly allow use in "marketing emails" in addition to web/partner pages (non-paid only). Is Redwood comfortable with adding that limited channel?
- They asked whether Redwood can commit to removing the logo within 10 business days of written request — BrightGrid wants that to be reciprocal.
- Regarding embargo dates, BrightGrid can commit to the internal preview on 2026-08-15 and will aim for public release 2026-08-22, but can accept a public release buffer if Redwood requests it.

I attached our annotated redline (we added a short reciprocal removal clause). If you can confirm, we'll submit final customer approval and I can send the customer's legal signoff.

Alex —

Thanks for the annotated redline and the additional asks. From a legal perspective Redwood can accept the limited changes with these final conditions:

1) Channels: add "marketing emails (non-paid)" to the permitted list. We will explicitly exclude co-branded paid campaigns or reseller kit distribution unless a separate agreement is signed.
2) Removal window: Redwood agrees to a reciprocal removal-on-request within 10 business days, with the caveat that cached content (search engines, archived copies) may persist; we will take reasonable steps to remove hosted assets.
3) Embargo: we'll accept BrightGrid's staged opt-in with this schedule in the order form: internal preview 2026-08-15; Redwood approval cutoff 2026-07-30; public release no earlier than 2026-08-22 but we request a final one-week buffer to 2026-08-29 if the marketing calendar needs it.
4) Final language: please see attached redline (embedded into the MSA/order form). The publicity clause we propose to insert into the order form is short and explicit — it references the customer-approved quote and logo license, plus an embargo line.

Next steps:
- Alex, if BrightGrid legal approves the attached redline we will prepare a DocuSign addendum and the logo asset package.
- Mina/Ben: I'd like marketing to prepare the small partner logo spec and host the asset zip on the Redwood CDN once signed.

If all good, I will generate the DocuSign link and include the agreed embargo dates on the order form as a simple field.

Olga Petrov
